expectedStart.label: 1 Ramadan 1448 AH
expectedStart.basis: Official Umm al-Qura calendar (S0): 1 Ramadan 1448 = 8 February 2027; S1-S4 agree.

lastTenNightsStart.label: Start of the last ten nights of Ramadan 1448 AH
lastTenNightsStart.basis: Official Umm al-Qura month grid (S0): 21 Ramadan 1448 = 28 February 2027. The 21st night begins at sunset on the evening before, 27 February 2027. Read from the published grid, not computed.

expectedEidAlFitr.label: 1 Shawwal 1448 AH (Eid al-Fitr)
expectedEidAlFitr.basis: Official Umm al-Qura calendar (S0): 1 Shawwal 1448 = 9 March 2027 (S1, S2 agree). The UK moon sighting predictions (S4) give 10 March 2027, and Gulf News (S3) gives 9 or 10 March, so the page shows the range 9-10 March 2027.

sources.publisher: Umm Al-Qura Calendar (official calendar of Saudi Arabia; government website)
sources.shown: 1448 AH month table: RAMADAN 09, February 8, 2027 - March 8, 2027 (1 Ramadan = 8 Feb, 21 Ramadan = 28 Feb, 27 Ramadan = 6 Mar, 29 Ramadan = 8 Mar); SHAWWAL 10, March 9, 2027 - April 7, 2027.
sources.method: Opened in ego-browser by the orchestrating run; the day grid was read from the page text (Hijri day -> Gregorian day).

sources.publisher: moonsighting.org.uk (UK moon-sighting predictions, Ramadan 1448 and Shawwal 1448 reports)

sources.pageDate: Reports last updated 07 April 2026 (page header shows Thursday 12 November 2026)

disagreements: Eid al-Fitr: Umm al-Qura-based sources (S1, S2) give 9 March 2027; the UK moonsighting.org.uk prediction (S4) gives 10 March 2027; Gulf News (S3) gives 9 or 10 March.
Ramadan start: no disagreement among S1-S4 (8 February 2027). Search snippets claimed 9 February for Bangladesh, but no Bangladesh official 1448 source was found, so it is not recorded here.
Low-quality outliers seen in search results and not used: teck.net (Eid 8 April 2027), Global Prayer Times (start ~18 Feb 2027), a calendar site listing 6 April 2027 as Laylat al-Qadr.
note: Expected dates; confirm with your local moon sighting.

seasonalSlot.derivedFrom: Derived, not sourced: start = expectedStart (2027-02-08) minus 14 days; end = latest expectedEidAlFitr (2027-03-10) plus 3 days. Proposed for T7.11; the window is an editorial choice.

notes: Official Saudi confirmation for Ramadan and Shawwal 1448 is pending; the official Umm al-Qura data source still needs to be checked directly before the page goes live.

Official confirmation added by the orchestrating run: the Umm al-Qura site (S0) loads in a full browser (the earlier fetch returned only its title). Umm al-Qura is a pre-computed calendar; local moon sighting may differ by a day, hence the note shown on the page.
